facts.fact: Wavemaker, Adwave's creative tool (vendor's own claim), generates ads in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 aspect ratios.
facts.quote: Wavemaker generates 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 (with 2:3 available via the API), up to 4K on the higher tiers.

facts.fact: Aspect ratio is written as width:height.
facts.quote: Aspect ratio is just the shape of the frame: the ratio of width to height. It's written as width:height.

facts.fact: The 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio is listed for YouTube, streaming TV (CTV), website video, and most display placements.
facts.quote: Where it goes:** YouTube, streaming TV (CTV), website video, and most display placements.

facts.fact: The 9:16 vertical aspect ratio is listed for TikTok, Instagram and Facebook Stories, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
facts.quote: Where it goes:** TikTok, Instagram and Facebook Stories, Reels, YouTube Shorts.

facts.fact: The 1:1 square and 4:5 portrait aspect ratios are both listed for Instagram and Facebook feeds.
facts.quote: Where it goes:** Instagram and Facebook feed posts, some display.

facts.fact: Adwave's Wavemaker tool exports ads at up to 4K resolution on its higher tiers, regardless of the aspect ratio chosen.
facts.quote: Wavemaker exports up to 4K on the higher tiers regardless of the shape you choose.

facts.fact: The page names four aspect ratios marketers commonly use for ads: 16:9 for wide, 9:16 for vertical, and 1:1 or 4:5 for the feed.
facts.quote: The four you'll use are 16:9 for wide, 9:16 for vertical, and 1:1 or 4:5 for the feed.
